## Wave 0 Summary

Three S117-investigator-surfaced **first-surfaced Q2 gaps** on the mack sole-writer surface, each a **designated-writer patch with an artifact-existence-with-content PASS predicate** (NOT a numerical threshold) and ~0 compute. These are registry-hygiene gates: they make an already-reconciled reading skim-proof, audit a label family for mutual consistency, or land a discharge-confirmation sub-row whose evidence already exists in the S117 verdict file. None mints a new prediction value (canonical write-order **Step 2 N/A** for all three — artifact-existence landings mint no `canonical_constants` value), and none changes a substrate-physics status (gate 0-3 confirms a *kinematic* discharge; DM survival stays **Reading A**, C11-conditional, UNCHANGED).

**Wave-classification note (`.claude/rules/wave-classification.md`).** All three gates **FAIL M4** (their gate-IDs are NOT in `methodology-wave-allowlist.md`), so they are **COMPUTE-class fallthrough** — they are NOT METHODOLOGY-class. Their PASS predicate is artifact-existence-with-content (the §M1 closure FORM), but they dispatch as compute gates that emit a verdict line via the `emit_verdict` knowledge-MCP tool, following the S117 W0-2 precedent (`Row #12.compute-S117-W0-ALPHAS-TILT-LANDING`: "artifact-existence falsifier-surface landing; trigger `[AUDIT]`; verdict line in `computations/session-117/s117_gate_verdicts.txt`, emitted via the `emit_verdict` knowledge-MCP tool; producing/verifier script … a grep-verifier consuming NO canonical constant"). Two of the three (0-2, 0-3) are pure grep-verifiers consuming NO canonical constant — see the **grep-verifier canonical-import exemption** baked into each block (a pre-registered WARN-only `python-validate` Check-1 exemption per `feedback_grep-verifier-canonical-import-exemption.md`, S117 W0-2 lesson; do NOT add a dead import, do NOT put `canonical_constants.py` in the audit_sha256 pinmap). Gate 0-1 legitimately imports `canonical_constants` (it numerically cross-checks four α_s values) and therefore takes NO exemption.

**Carry-forward provenance**: each gate consumes only already-landed S117 artifacts (verdict lines, registry sections, canonical constants). No upstream S118 compute is required; Wave 0 is independent of Waves 1–3.

## Wave 0 → Wave 1 Decision Point

Wave 0 is **independent of Waves 1–3** and gates no downstream compute. Two orchestrator-side **1c-REGISTERS.MAINTAIN** folds are keyed to W0 verdicts (these are register-prose folds effected by the orchestrator, NOT dispatched compute gates):

| W0 verdict | Orchestrator MAINTAIN fold (NOT a gate) |
|:-----------|:----------------------------------------|
| 0-1 PASS (Branch A annotation OR Branch B no-edit) | the α_s family is certified single-label-conflation-proof; no EVOI/atlas change required beyond recording the determination |
| 0-3 PASS | EVOI §1 "170× DM-mass" standing gap → marked **RESOLVED-on-kinematics** at the S118 re-stamp (the CF-W4-1 EVOI pair; effected at `/rclab-plan` Step 1c-REGISTERS.MAINTAIN, per `sessions/session-plan/session-118-context.md` §"Phase 1c-REGISTERS.MAINTAIN") |

If any W0 gate returns FAIL (landing/verify failure), the orchestrator re-dispatches a minimal write-only follow-up (per `.claude/rules/agent-standards.md §"Completion Verification"`); the EVOI 170× fold is HELD until 0-3 PASS lands.
